main_text.l: Concilio Seleucienfi Vicarius, qui Patribus de ὁμοούσιον (vehementer vti par erat) contendentibus, Abite (inquit) & in Ecclesia nugas agite : Non sic olim Basilius, qui (referente Theodoreto) Valentis Imperatoris Præfecto, vnius literulæ veniam suadenti, respondit, Qui diuinis innutriti sunt eloquijs, corrumpere de diuinis dogmatibus ne vnam quidem syllabam patiuntur, sed pro his si contingat, omnes etiam mortis species ampleEctuntur: Non sic Eleusius, & Syluanus Episcopi orthodoxi, non reliqui illi bone Deus ! quam fidi custodes, &(qui Athanasio titulus)

page.notes: Greek word ὁμοούσιον is printed in a small italic form and was transcribed approximately. The line "tulus)" at the foot is a catchword-like continuation of the text and has been kept as the last words of the paragraph. Marginal notes transcribed as printed; the section marks on the right are reading-order approximations. Faint show-through from the reverse page is ignored.
